ambiguities.source_text: Group together the Loyalty_Tiers into Gold, Silver and Bronze
ambiguities.intent: Trim surrounding whitespace and match tier names case-insensitively. Normalize Gold, Silver and Bronze to their canonical names; correct the supplied spelling variants Goald to Gold, Sliver to Silver and Bronz to Bronze. Missing or unrecognized values remain null.

ambiguities.source_text:
Create a Sales_After_Discount field to apply the Loyalty_Discount for transactions with a Loyalty_Number
  - If Loyalty_Number, Loyalty_Discount, or Sales_Before_Discount is missing, leave Sales_After_Discount null. Keep these transaction records.
ambiguities.ref:
discount_mask = (
        transactions["Loyalty_Number"].notna()
        & transactions["Loyalty_Discount"].notna()
        & transactions["Sales_Before_Discount"].notna()
    )
sales_after_values = (
        transactions.loc[discount_mask, "Sales_Before_Discount"].map(lambda x: Decimal(str(x)))
        * (Decimal(1) - transactions.loc[discount_mask, "Loyalty_Discount"].map(lambda x: Decimal(str(x))))
    )
ambiguities.intent: Apply Sales_Before_Discount * (1 - Loyalty_Discount) only when Loyalty_Number, Loyalty_Discount and Sales_Before_Discount are all present. Otherwise leave Sales_After_Discount null and retain the transaction row; do not substitute zero discount or the original sales amount.

ambiguities.source_text:
Calculate the Profit, defined as:
  - Sales_After_Discount - (Unit_Cost * Quantity)
  - If Sales_After_Discount is null, leave Profit null.
  - Round Profit to 2 decimal places using half-up rounding.
ambiguities.intent: Profit is Sales_After_Discount - (Unit_Cost * Quantity), using the unrounded discount calculation as specified in the full requirements. If Sales_After_Discount is null, leave Profit null; do not replace missing profit with zero. Round the final Profit to 2 decimal places using half-up rounding (ROUND_HALF_UP), not half-to-even.
